description: Do you sometimes feel like Sunday worship has become just another routine? Sunday morning worship is a powerful opportunity to encounter God, but how often do we come unprepared or distracted? In this message, we’ll explore how to get the most out of our worship by preparing our hearts, minds, and spirits in advance. From eliminating distractions to setting expectations for encountering God, we’ll discover practical steps to engage deeply and experience His presence in a transformative way. Worship isn’t just about showing up — it’s about showing up ready to meet with God. Let’s learn how to be fully present and open to what He wants to do in our lives each Sunday.

title: Living the Parable of the Good Samaritan - Kevin Kiefer
description:
Have you ever been unexpectedly touched by an act of kindness?

In this week's episode of Thrive Vineyard Church Sermon of the Week, we embark on a journey through the parable of the Good Samaritan. Pastor Kevin draws insightful parallels between this timeless story and our modern lives, urging us to recognize and respond to the brokenness around us. Be prepared to rethink your own capacity for compassion and sacrifice as we examine the importance of loving our neighbors, regardless of the personal cost involved.

Join us on this transformative journey to not only learn about, but to also start living out the sacrificial, compassionate love that truly marks us as followers of Christ.

title: Mediterranean Messages: Galatians - Molly Kiefer
description:
Is self-help getting you the life you want?  Feeling stuck and wondering if your best effort can really produce the results you hope for?
Our culture idolizes self-improvement and hustle. But Paul’s message cuts through this noise: only by surrendering to Christ, allowing Him to live through us, can we experience true freedom and transformation.
This sermon invites you to reframe your life’s narrative, making Jesus the central character. Are you ready to shift your perspective, relinquish control, and live a life of unshakeable faith? Dive into Galatians and discover the liberating power of the Gospel.

title: Be Filled: A Pentecost Sermon - Kevin Kiefer
description:
Have you ever felt a longing for a deeper connection with God?

This Pentecost Sunday, join us as we explore the transformative power of the Holy Spirit.

Pastor Kevin dives into the thrilling account of Pentecost from Acts 2, revealing a pivotal shift. Discover the impact of how God's presence moved from a physical location inside the temple to reside within believers themselves, ready to empower and transform us.

Imagine living a life overflowing with God's love, radiating joy, and impacting the world around you. This sermon unpacks the key to unlocking this reality – the infilling of the Holy Spirit.

title: The Power of Spiritual Gifts in Building Community - Wendy Seidman
description:
Feeling like a puzzle piece searching for its place within the bigger picture? This week, we delve into the beautiful tapestry of spiritual gifts!

Remember the story of the early Church, a fledgling community brimming with potential but lacking direction? Today, we unlock the secret weapon gifted by the Holy Spirit – the unique talents He bestows on each believer.

Join us as we explore 1 Corinthians 12, where the Apostle Paul unveils this extraordinary truth. Discover the spectrum of gifts, from the fiery passion of encouragement to the steady hand of service.

Imagine using your God-given skills to not only enrich your own faith, but to build up the entire body of Christ! This sermon equips you to identify your gift and unleash its potential, fostering a thriving and impactful faith community.

Don't miss this chance to discover the unique role you were created to play!

title: Restored by His Reign - Kevin Kiefer
description:
This week, Pastor Kevin grapples with the concept of living in the "now and not yet" of the Kingdom of God.  How do we live as conduits of God's Kingdom while making peace with the reality that God doesn't always act the way that we expect Him to?
The sermon concludes with a challenge to cultivate faith and live as active agents in bringing about God's will. Join us this Sunday as we are challenged to cultivate faith and embrace the tension of the now and not yet, trusting in God's ultimate plan while actively fighting for healing and transformation in the present.

title: How to Build a Boat - Molly Kiefer
description: Pastor Molly Kiefer uses the universally relatable experience of being unprepared for a big event to illustrate divine preparation in our spiritual lives. Through the story of Noah in Genesis 6, she shows how Noah’s faithfulness and close walk with God equipped him for his monumental task. Pastor Molly emphasizes the importance of being attuned to God’s voice, sharing a personal story of prayer and gratitude that led to an unexpected discovery. Reflecting on Noah’s immediate and humble obedience, she encourages us to reignite our commitment to God’s kingdom, focusing on His plans for redemption and restoration. This message is a stirring call to embrace urgent obedience and a humble walk with God.

title: In the Grip of God - Kevin Kiefer
description: In the book of Genesis, we meet Jacob. Jacob was Isaac's son, and as we hear his story, we discover that Jacob was a person who struggled to trust God. When Jacob had a need, he worked hard to get what he wanted, even if that meant manipulating or hurting others so that he could get ahead. In this sermon, Kevin shows us how sometimes when we ask God for help, God chooses instead to give us something far greater than what we asked for. But HOW God works blessing into our lives may surprise us!
